content:
maria_marketing: Quick thread to finalize webinar positioning and the short battlecard for SDR routing. Two parallel asks: 1) bench narrative + slide blurb we can show live, 2) routing rules for webinar leads (trial vs enterprise). Deadline: Tue EOD.

aj_research: Dropping sanitized bench highlights from recent run (do not publish raw URLs yet):

```text
Workload: conversational assistant, avg session 320 tokens
Testbed: us-west-2, H100-equivalent, steady-state 70% util, 500 concurrent sessions simulated
Redwood Inference (opt-profile): p50 35ms, p95 95ms, cost-per-convo $0.015
CloudY API (managed): p50 88ms, p95 210ms, cost-per-convo $0.045
InfraX self-host baseline: p50 28ms, p95 320ms (degrades under burst), cost-per-convo $0.025
```

maria_marketing: Good. Let's be careful: use relative phrasing on public slide (e.g., "~2-3x lower p95 vs CloudY in our tests"). Include the testbed one-liner.

leo_sales: For routing, suggestion: tag attendees with intent signals. If they click "Dedicated SLA" or ask pricing -> route to enterprise-sales. If they click "Start free trial" -> route to trial-nurture SDR queue. We should add a third path: "Compliance/Private" -> Solutions Eng.

nora_content: Draft hero options for webinar landing (short):
A) "Serve LLMs reliably — predictable p95, transparent economics, failover that keeps apps healthy."
B) "Inference that scales predictably — lower tail latency, clearer unit costs, and built-in fallbacks."
C) "Make LLMs production-ready — consistent latency, economical serving, and outage-proof fallbacks."

aj_research: My vote is B (tight and benefits-forward).

maria_marketing: Agree B feels good. Nora, please produce two variants (long and short) for A/B test in signups.

leo_sales: Also need two quick SDR hooks for the one-pager. Something like: "Worried about tail latency in peak traffic? We keep p95 predictable and provide fallback model tiers." And "Want to lower inference spend without losing quality? Our batching + kv-cache profiles cut unit costs."

nora_content: I'll write those up. Also adding a 2-line benchmark blurb for the slide: "In our internal tests (us-west-2, H100-class nodes), Redwood delivered ~2-3x lower p95 latency vs CloudY on multi-turn chat while reducing cost-per-conversation by ~60% in the tested workload. Results vary by model and workload."

aj_research: Add a short caveat line: "Test conditions: quantized model profile, steady state 70% GPU util, synthetic traffic with varied sequence lengths. See appendix for methodology."

maria_marketing: Perfect. Now routing rules specifics (Leo): can you draft exact form fields and routing triggers for the registration flow? We want to avoid false enterprise routes.

leo_sales: Draft routing logic: fields: company size (dropdown), intended usage (trial/pilot/prod), compliance needs (checkbox), SLA interest (checkbox), estimated monthly convs (numeric). Triggers: 
- Enterprise route -> if SLA interest OR company size > 500 OR intended usage == prod
- Solutions Eng -> if compliance needs checked OR private deployment interest checked
- Trial SDR nurture -> else default
I'll mock the exact webhook payload structure and send by EOD.

deploy_bot: form-hook: new-registration event available at /webhooks/marketing/registrations (internal)

maria_marketing: Great. Final deliverables and owners: Nora -> landing copy + hero A/B variants by Mon 9am PT; Aj -> sanitized bench slide text + caveat by Mon noon; Leo -> routing webhook + sample payload + SDR one-pager hooks by Mon 5pm; I'll assemble the battlecard and run a 15m dry-run Tue morning.

nora_content: On it. Will push copy to the shared folder and tag.

aj_research: I'll also sanitize graphs (no infra names) and provide a short chart we can embed.

leo_sales: I'll include a short procurement script for the SDRs: 2 lines on reserved vs on-demand math and pointer to SLA docs.

maria_marketing: Important: label bench slide as "internal" until legal reviews the wording. Everyone be conservative with absolute claims. Use "in our tests" and relative language.

nora_content: noted. Also thinking of a quick webinar poll: choose your biggest pain: a) tail latency b) cost per convo c) uptime/failover. That will help routing and follow-up content.

maria_marketing: Love it. Add poll to the slide deck and wire the response to the registration payload so SDRs get the pain signal.

deploy_bot: poll-widget: polling v2 added to slides via /assets/widgets/poll-v2.json

maria_marketing: OK team — thanks. We'll reconvene Tue 8:45am PT for the dry-run. If anyone hits blockers, drop them here.

(END)
